summary: Tested new chat response-language picker feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed covering backwards compatibility (no field), 'auto', hindi (Devanagari), hinglish (Roman only), konkani-deva, konkani-romi, translation format preservation with hindi reply language, optional/null/empty response_language acceptance, and chat history endpoint. Frontend: All 6 user flows passed — both chips render in composer (dictate left + new chat-response-lang right with AUTO ✨ default), bottom sheet opens with full language list, selecting Konkani (Romi) updates chip to 🇮🇳 KO-RO, sending a message returned a real Konkani reply in Roman/Latin script with zero Devanagari, selection persisted across History→Chat navigation, and the dictate chip stayed at EN-US independent of the response-language chip. No deprecated packages or React Native issues detected in the new picker component.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatResponseLanguagePicker, useChatResponseLanguage, chatResponseLanguages.ts, prompts.build_chat_response_language_directive are all well-structured. Pub/sub hook keeps multiple consumers in sync without Context. Backend directive only injected for non-empty/non-'auto' codes — preserves backwards compatibility cleanly.
seed_data_creation: None — used disposable session_ids per test; backend writes to chat_messages collection which is non-critical.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL var in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Onboarding flow on web: SKIP → CONTINUE AS GUEST → setup-finish-btn → tabs available. Chat tab is navigable via [href*='chat']. New picker testIDs: chat-response-lang-chip (composer chip), chat-response-lang-{code} (sheet rows). Konkani Romi LLM output confirmed: 'Yeta tea vellar, soglem boreak zatolem...' — Roman-only, no Devanagari, exactly per spec.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. Feature works end-to-end as designed.
